ACCIDENTS AND OCCUPATIONAL DISEASES (NOTIFICATION) ACT (R.S.A. c. A10)
OCCUPATIONAL DISEASES REGULATIONS
Note: These Regulations are enabled under section 7(2) of the Accidents and Occupational Diseases
(Notification) Act, R.S.A. c. A10.
Occupational diseases
1. The diseases set out in the Schedule are hereby declared to be occupational diseases for the purposes of
the Accidents and Occupational Diseases (Notification) Act.
Citation
2. These Regulations may be cited as the Occupational Diseases Regulations, Revised Regulations of
Anguilla A10-1.
___________
